Semantic summary: a 0x03001eec battle-work sub-effect taking (object, mode). Registers the object pointer at work+0x7828, opens two draw-rectangle blit kinds (46 and 47) via Func_080ed408, copies a mode-selected palette (Value_0000007c for mode 0, Value_0000007b for mode 1) through the generic word-copy trampoline, then seeds a 256-slot particle pool at 0x02010000 from one party member's position (offsets 8/12/16 of the member struct already established by member_orbit/080d82b0) with randomized polar-coordinate offsets, halved when mode==0. Runs 128 frames: each frame redraws whichever of the first 128 particles has both cleared its staggered `(j/32)*8` reveal threshold and has a non-negative phase field (itself reused as the per-particle rotation-angle seed), projecting through Func_080e3944, computing a distance-banded sprite index via a two-sided screen[2] clamp and a Data_080ede48[] table lookup, blitting through the kind-46 routine (an indirectly-called, genuinely traced function pointer, not a fictional 'Func_080072f4'), and -- in mode 1 only -- nudging the particle's stored y-bias field by +-8192 depending on the sign of the seed member's own offset-8 field. Each frame also drives one staggered Func_080d6888 portrait callout per party member, with mode 0 additionally cueing a sound (Func_080f9010(126)) and using a persistent -1 argument where mode 1 uses a literal 5.

The r3-slot and r4-slot _call_via_rN indirect calls (games/gs1/asm/080072e4.s) were both confirmed by literal address arithmetic before modeling: 0x080072f0 - 0x080072e4 = 0xC = 4*3 (the r3 slot, hence Func_080072f0's real callee is the 0x03001388 word-copy routine passed as its trailing 4th argument, matching the established 080d82b0/080e7404 convention exactly), and 0x080072f4 - 0x080072e4 = 0x10 = 4*4 (the r4 slot, hence the per-frame draw call is a real indirect call through the traced `draw_rectangle_fn` variable, not a call to a fictional 'Func_080072f4' symbol).
No GS2 or external source was used; no other Golden Sun decompilation project was consulted; no other in-progress worktree's output was read.
